basicInformation.title: Basic Information
basicInformation.name: Name
basicInformation.nameTooltip: Must be unique. Alphanumeric characters and "_" only. No spaces allowed. Maximum 30 characters.

taskLanguage.title: Task & Language
taskLanguage.taskTypeTooltip: Select the type of task this configuration will handle
taskLanguage.languageTooltip: Select the primary language for processing queries; only enabled languages are currently supported, with others coming soon.

llm.title: LLM
llm.primaryLLMTooltip: Generates a clear, searchable question from the live conversation. This question is then matched against your Q&A cache.
llm.secondaryLLMTooltip: Refines the question generated by the Primary LLM for better cache matching. Enable for improved accuracy.
llm.modelTooltip: Select the language model to use for processing
llm.promptTemplateTooltip: Please specify the instructions for question generation. Any changes will create a new version.

semanticSimilarity.title: Caching
semanticSimilarity.similarityModelTooltip: Please select the model used for computing semantic similarity between questions.
semanticSimilarity.similarityThresholdTooltip: Minimum score required for a cache match. Lower values return more results; higher values ensure accuracy.
semanticSimilarity.disabledMessage: Caching is currently disabled. Enable it to configure the similarity model and threshold for improved cache matching.

serviceSettings.title: Service Settings
serviceSettings.kaasFallbackTooltip: When enabled, queries that fall below the similarity threshold will be sent to the full KaaS service for answer generation.
serviceSettings.autoCacheResultsTooltip: Automatically adds new Q&A pairs from KaaS responses to the cache.
